answer: Pay each identity its leave-one-out marginal value. At close, rerun the epoch's scoring with that identity removed and pay it the drop in total useful output. A clone echoing a sibling is one more grain on a dune: pull it out and the score barely moves, so 10 clones split about one share while each still burns full compute. An agent rooted like a cedar in distinct work keeps its pay. Failure mode: clones vary output just enough to look additive; audit random pairs and merge any pair whose joint drop far exceeds its solo drops, so the pool is no haven for farms.
